parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-streaming-data-sources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-bp10g78o9807yv9h3 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
